body.statement: In the published model of Dwivedi et al., an exogenous quantity is generated independently of all other sources of randomness, equation (4) generates each potential outcome from treatment-indexed exogenous unit and time factors plus exogenous noise, and the model expressly requires the counterfactual at a decision time not to depend on past treatment.

source.locator: pages 2382--2383, definition of exogenous, equation (1) discussion, and equation (4)

attestation.note: Checked against the accepted-version source and PDF; the equation and published pagination agree.
